turn1.explanation: Responds to the word 'coffee' and coffee drinks (latte, mocha), strongest when coffee is mentioned as something to drink or a social occasion. It responds more weakly to related places and terms (café, coffeehouse, barista) and weakly to 'Java' the programming language, probably through its coffee association.
turn1.evidence: Every top example peaks on 'coffee', 'latte' or 'm[ocha]', even in technical text ('coffee house', 'coffee maker'). Café/barista tokens reach 6-7, and 'Java' in programming contexts reaches only about 4.
